`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, but I haven't run it end to end. The cli module's tests pass offline. The help output and the overview listing are unverified, because running the compiled CLI and `git diff` both needed approval I couldn't get.

Changes, all in `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/`:

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview with the same landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**:
  - The dispatch in `run` accepts either name and goes to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method, so both run identical code with identical options.
  - `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed (`args[0]`), with the analyze description when that name is `analyzeLandscape`. `updateLandscape -help` keeps its own description.

I did not change the README. It only covers build and Docker and has no command descriptions, so there was nothing to update. If you want a command reference added there, say so and I'll write one.

I did not commit.
